function.name: get_structure_from_mp_text
function.description: Retrieve a pymatgen structure from Materials Project using its API and return CIF content as text.

function.name: enumerate_slabs_text
function.description: Enumerate all possible surface slab terminations from a bulk structure and return as JSON.

bulk_cif.description: Bulk crystal structure in CIF string format.

miller_index.description: Miller indices for surface orientation. Defaults to (1,1,1).

min_slab_size.description: Minimum slab thickness in Angstroms. Defaults to 12.

min_vacuum_size.description: Minimum vacuum layer thickness in Angstroms. Defaults to 5.

function.name: choose_slab_text
function.description: Select a specific slab from a JSON dictionary of enumerated slabs by index.

slabs_json.description: JSON string mapping slab keys to CIF strings.

index.description: Index of the slab to select. Defaults to 0.

function.name: get_adsorption_sites_text
function.description: Identify and classify all possible adsorption sites on a surface slab.

slab_cif.description: CIF string of the surface slab structure.

function.name: choose_adsorption_site_text
function.description: Select a specific adsorption site from classified sites by type and index.

adsorption_sites_json.description: JSON string mapping site types to lists of fractional coordinates.

site_type.description: Type of adsorption site to select.

index.description: Index of the site within the specified type. Defaults to 0.

function.name: add_adsorbate_to_slab_text
function.description: Place an adsorbate molecule on a surface slab at a specified adsorption site.

slab_cif.description: CIF string of the surface slab structure.

adsorbate_cif.description: CIF string of the adsorbate molecule structure.

height.description: Height in Angstroms above the surface for adsorbate placement. Defaults to 2.0.

site.description: Optional fractional coordinates for adsorbate placement.
